_README: Per-platform screen-reader announcements that differ from the Unicode CLDR baseline. Keys are the codepoint sequence (uppercase hex, joined by '-') matching data.json. Values may include any of: apple, windows, android. Optional _note and _source fields document why. Anything not listed inherits the CLDR baseline. Exact strings depend on screen reader version, OS version, locale, and verbosity settings — this file captures the typical default-verbosity output reported by published sources.

1F3F4-E0067-E0062-E0065-E006E-E0067-E007._note: Subdivision flag (England). Apple VoiceOver announces the place name; Windows Narrator and Android TalkBack typically fall back to 'flag' or read the tag characters.

1F3F4-E0067-E0062-E0073-E0063-E0074-E006._note: Subdivision flag (Scotland). Apple VoiceOver announces the place name; Windows Narrator and Android TalkBack typically fall back to 'flag'.

1F3F4-E0067-E0062-E0077-E006C-E0073-E007._note: Subdivision flag (Wales). Apple VoiceOver announces the place name; other platforms typically fall back to 'flag'.

1F3F3-FE0F-200D-1F308._note: Rainbow flag. Apple VoiceOver says 'rainbow flag'; CLDR uses the same. Windows Narrator on older versions may announce 'white flag, rainbow' as two separate emoji.

1F3F3-FE0F-200D-26A7-FE0F._note: Transgender flag. Older Windows Narrator versions decompose ZWJ sequences into their parts.

1F3F4-200D-2620-FE0F._note: Pirate flag. Older Narrator decomposes the ZWJ sequence.

1F44D-1F3FB._note: Skin-tone modifiers: Apple and Android announce the tone verbally; older Windows Narrator versions may only say the base emoji and omit the tone.

1F44D-1F3FC._note: Skin-tone modifiers: Apple and Android announce the tone verbally; older Windows Narrator versions may omit it.

1F44B-1F3FB._note: Apple announces the modifier with a comma; CLDR uses a colon.

1F468-200D-1F4BB._note: ZWJ profession sequence. Modern platforms render as a single phrase; older Narrator decomposes to component parts.

1F468-200D-1F469-200D-1F466._note: Family emoji. Apple typically announces as a composite phrase; Narrator may read each member separately.

2764-FE0F-200D-1F525._note: Heart on fire. Older Narrator decomposes ZWJ sequences.

2764-FE0F-200D-1FA79._note: Mending heart. Older Narrator decomposes ZWJ sequences.

1F600._note: No platform divergence — included as a sanity-check entry. All major readers announce 'grinning face'.
